convert_cvt_checkpoint: convert a Microsoft CvT PyTorch checkpoint to a HuggingFace transformers model
run_convert_cli_cvt: run the CvT checkpoint conversion CLI with model name, image size, and output path arguments
rename_embeddings_weights: rename CvT embedding layer weights from original model format to HuggingFace format
rename_attention_weights: rename CvT attention block weights including query, key, value projections and MLP layers
rename_cls_token_weights: rename CvT cls_token weights from original model to HuggingFace stage format
